Let me scale up to N=1e6 across the full set of z-points (0.25 through 10, with z=5 as index 8), timing suggests 1e6 histories take around 10 seconds plus NEE overhead, so I'll run with N=1e6 for the main point while watching memory usage for stored collision data.
